svg.title: Basic Rollup: system architecture
svg.desc: rollup_client signs v1 transactions and sends them over HTTP to rollup_core. Inside rollup_core the HTTP frontend passes each request to the sequencer over an mpsc channel. The sequencer runs six phases (decode, validate, load, budget, process, commit) and alone owns RollupDB, which holds accounts, transactions and resolved addresses. RollupDB pulls unseen accounts from a Solana cluster with getMultipleAccounts. The settlement boundary reports not_configured; settlement through a devnet program is planned and its mechanism is not decided.
svg.text: One Rust server holds the HTTP frontend, the sequencer, account state and receipts, and the settlement boundary. A separate client signs v1 transactions.
one process · HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8080 (ROLLUP_BIND) · state in memory, reset on restart
optional when a cluster is set
→ Balance, pulls the account if unseen
Sequencer::run, on the thread named sequencer, takes one SequencerMessage at a time.
It alone owns RollupDB, so no reader sees a partly committed transaction.
Submit runs execute(): six phases, in order
devnet, Mainnet or a local validator
feature snapshot and rent vs Mainnet
a pulled account vs a real cluster
copies each unseen account once, during load or for
GET /get_account; later cluster changes are not seen.
CLUSTER_TIMEOUT 10 s, then HTTP 503, no fee.
Nothing is written back and nothing locks it there.
run by cargo xtask, not by the server
Labels use the names in rollup_core/src and rollup_client/src.
